<title>Galerie Numismatique</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=EB+Garamond:ital@0;1&display=swap">

<style>
:root {
  --bg: #080808;
  --surface: #101010;
  --surface2: #181818;
  --fg: #e8e2d9;
  --fg2: #a09888;
  --accent: #c9a84c;
  --accent2: #e8c96a;
  --muted: #333;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root:not([data-theme="dark"]) {
    --bg: #f5f0e8;
    --surface: #ede7db;
    --surface2: #e0d9cc;
    --fg: #1a1410;
    --fg2: #5a4e3c;
    --accent: #8b6914;
    --accent2: #b08a20;
    --muted: #ccc5b5;
    color-scheme: light;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg: #f5f0e8; --surface: #ede7db; --surface2: #e0d9cc;
  --fg: #1a1410; --fg2: #5a4e3c; --accent: #8b6914; --accent2: #b08a20;
  --muted: #ccc5b5; color-scheme: light;
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html, body { height: 100%; }
body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* ── Particles ── */
#particles {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden;
}
.particle {
  position: absolute;
  width: 2px; height: 2px;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: float-up linear infinite;
}
@keyframes float-up {
  0%   { transform: translateY(0) scale(1);   opacity: 0; }
  10%  { opacity: 0.6; }
  80%  { opacity: 0.3; }
  100% { transform: translateY(-100vh) scale(0.3); opacity: 0; }
}

/* ── Header ── */
header {
  position: relative; z-index: 10;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 5rem 1rem 2.5rem;
}
.header-line {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1.2rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}
.header-line::before, .header-line::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1; max-width: 200px;
  height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--accent), transparent);
}
header h1 {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.8rem);
  font-weight: 300;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fg);
  text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(201,168,76,0.15);
}
header p {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--fg2);
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-style: italic;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}
.accent-dot { color: var(--accent); }

/* ── Gallery grid ── */
.gallery {
  position: relative; z-index: 5;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 320px), 1fr));
  gap: 2rem;
  padding: 2rem 2rem 4rem;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ── Card ── */
.card {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--muted);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(40px) scale(0.97);
  transition: opacity 0.9s ease, transform 0.9s ease,
              border-color 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.card.visible {
  opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
}
.card:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(201,168,76,0.18), 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  z-index: 2;
}
.card:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0s; }
.card:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
.card:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }

/* ── Photo wrapper + Ken Burns ── */
.photo-wrap {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
}
.photo-wrap img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transform-origin: center center;
  transition: transform 6s ease;
}
.card:hover .photo-wrap img {
  transform: scale(1.08) translate(1%, -1%);
}

/* ── Watermark overlay on photo ── */
.watermark {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.watermark::after {
  content: 'numismatique@noir-blanc.fr';
  position: absolute;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.8vw, 0.85rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  transform: rotate(-30deg);
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
  /* Repeat via multiple text-shadow to tile the watermark */
  text-shadow:
    0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28),
    200px -100px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18),
    -200px 100px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18),
    0 200px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18),
    0 -200px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18),
    400px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12),
    -400px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
}

/* ── Shimmer on hover ── */
.photo-wrap::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(105deg,
    transparent 40%,
    rgba(201,168,76,0.12) 50%,
    transparent 60%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  background-position: -100% 0;
  transition: background-position 0.6s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.card:hover .photo-wrap::after {
  background-position: 200% 0;
}

/* ── Gold border reveal on hover ── */
.card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 3;
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.card:hover::before { opacity: 0.6; }

/* ── Card caption ── */
.caption {
  padding: 1rem 1.2rem 1.3rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--muted);
  position: relative;
}
.caption::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 1.2rem; right: 1.2rem;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent), transparent);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
}
.card:hover .caption::before { opacity: 1; }
.caption h3 {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 400;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}
.caption p {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--fg2);
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── View hint ── */
.view-hint {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.8);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.72);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.35s, transform 0.35s;
  pointer-events: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  z-index: 4;
}
.card:hover .view-hint {
  opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
}

/* ── Lightbox ── */
#lightbox {
  display: none;
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.94);
  cursor: pointer;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;
}
#lightbox.open {
  display: flex;
  animation: lb-in 0.35s ease;
}
@keyframes lb-in {
  from { opacity: 0; backdrop-filter: blur(0px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
}
#lb-img {
  max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
  max-height: 82vh;
  object-fit: contain;
  box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,76,0.25);
  animation: lb-zoom 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1);
  cursor: default;
}
@keyframes lb-zoom {
  from { transform: scale(0.82); opacity: 0; }
  to   { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}
#lb-caption {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-style: italic;
}
#lb-close {
  position: fixed; top: 1.5rem; right: 1.8rem;
  font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--fg2); cursor: pointer;
  background: none; border: none; line-height: 1;
  transition: color 0.2s;
}
#lb-close:hover { color: var(--accent); }
#lb-prev, #lb-next {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: rgba(201,168,76,0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.3);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s;
  user-select: none;
}
#lb-prev { left: 1rem; }
#lb-next { right: 1rem; }
#lb-prev:hover, #lb-next:hover { background: rgba(201,168,76,0.25); }

/* ── Email corner badge ── */
#email-badge {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 1.5rem; right: 1.5rem;
  z-index: 50;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
  background: rgba(8,8,8,0.88);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.2s;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}
#email-badge:hover {
  background: rgba(201,168,76,0.12);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(201,168,76,0.25);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
#email-badge svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}
#email-badge span {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--fg);
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
}
#copy-feedback {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 5rem; right: 1.5rem;
  z-index: 51;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #000;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
  border-radius: 2px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(5px);
  transition: opacity 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
  pointer-events: none;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
}
#copy-feedback.show {
  opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ── Footer ── */
footer {
  position: relative; z-index: 5;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem 1rem 3rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--muted);
  margin-top: 1rem;
}
footer p {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--fg2);
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  font-style: italic;
}
</style>

<div id="particles"></div>

<header>
  <div class="header-line">
    <h1>Numismatique <span class="accent-dot">&amp;</span> Collections</h1>
  </div>
  <p>Pièces rares &middot; Médailles &middot; Ordres militaires</p>
</header>

<main class="gallery">

  <div class="card" data-index="0" data-title="Monnaies d'Or Suisses">
    <div class="photo-wrap">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pièces d'or suisses empilées" loading="lazy">
      <div class="watermark"></div>
      <div class="view-hint">Agrandir</div>
    </div>
    <div class="caption">
      <h3>Or · Suisse</h3>
      <p>Monnaies d'or helvétiques — Qualité collection</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card" data-index="1" data-title="Collection Numismatique">
    <div class="photo-wrap">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pièces d'or suisses étalées" loading="lazy">
      <div class="watermark"></div>
      <div class="view-hint">Agrandir</div>
    </div>
    <div class="caption">
      <h3>Collection</h3>
      <p>Ensemble de monnaies dorées de haute qualité</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card" data-index="2" data-title="Ordres Militaires Impériaux">
    <div class="photo-wrap">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ordres militaires russes" loading="lazy">
      <div class="watermark"></div>
      <div class="view-hint">Agrandir</div>
    </div>
    <div class="caption">
      <h3>Ordres Impériaux</h3>
      <p>Ordres militaires russes — XIXe &amp; XXe siècle</p>
    </div>
  </div>

</main>

<div id="lightbox" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Image agrandie">
  <button id="lb-close" aria-label="Fermer">&times;</button>
  <button id="lb-prev" aria-label="Précédent">&#8249;</button>
  <img id="lb-img" src="" alt="">
  <div id="lb-caption"></div>
  <button id="lb-next" aria-label="Suivant">&#8250;</button>
</div>

<div id="email-badge" role="button" tabindex="0" title="Copier l'adresse e-mail" aria-label="Copier numismatique@noir-blanc.fr">
  <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2"/>
    <path d="m2 7 10 7 10-7"/>
  </svg>
  <span>numismatique@noir-blanc.fr</span>
</div>
<div id="copy-feedback">Copié !</div>

<footer>
  <p>Pièces et médailles de collection · Estimation sur demande</p>
</footer>

<script>
// ── Particles ──────────────────────────────
(function() {
  const container = document.getElementById('particles');
  const N = 22;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'particle';
    const size = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
    p.style.cssText = [
      `left: ${Math.random()*100}%`,
      `top: ${80 + Math.random()*20}%`,
      `width: ${size}px`,
      `height: ${size}px`,
      `animation-duration: ${8 + Math.random()*14}s`,
      `animation-delay: ${Math.random()*12}s`,
      `opacity: 0`
    ].join(';');
    container.appendChild(p);
  }
})();

// ── Scroll reveal ──────────────────────────
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); observer.unobserve(e.target); } });
}, { threshold: 0.12 });
document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c => observer.observe(c));

// ── Lightbox ──────────────────────────────
const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.card'));
const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
const lbImg = document.getElementById('lb-img');
const lbCap = document.getElementById('lb-caption');
let cur = 0;

function openLb(idx) {
  cur = ((idx % cards.length) + cards.length) % cards.length;
  const card = cards[cur];
  lbImg.src = card.querySelector('img').src;
  lbImg.alt = card.querySelector('img').alt;
  lbCap.textContent = card.dataset.title || '';
  lb.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeLb() {
  lb.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

cards.forEach((c, i) => c.addEventListener('click', () => openLb(i)));
document.getElementById('lb-close').addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); closeLb(); });
lb.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === lb) closeLb(); });
document.getElementById('lb-prev').addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openLb(cur - 1); });
document.getElementById('lb-next').addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openLb(cur + 1); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (!lb.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLb();
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') openLb(cur - 1);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') openLb(cur + 1);
});

// ── Email copy ────────────────────────────
const badge = document.getElementById('email-badge');
const feedback = document.getElementById('copy-feedback');
let fbTimer;

function copyEmail() {
  const email = 'numismatique@noir-blanc.fr';
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(email).then(() => {
    showFeedback();
  }).catch(() => {
    // Fallback: select text
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    const range = document.createRange();
    range.selectNodeContents(badge.querySelector('span'));
    sel.removeAllRanges();
    sel.addRange(range);
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch(e) {}
    sel.removeAllRanges();
    showFeedback();
  });
}
function showFeedback() {
  clearTimeout(fbTimer);
  feedback.classList.add('show');
  fbTimer = setTimeout(() => feedback.classList.remove('show'), 1800);
}
badge.addEventListener('click', copyEmail);
badge.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); copyEmail(); } });
badge.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { badge.title = 'Cliquer pour copier'; });
</script>
